title: Selection rail: thumbs on a hairline with square markers, the current frame and marker amber, joined by a short connector
use: The left list of a detail screen (modes, operators, weapons, vehicles) or an in-game picker. 3-6 items.
relations: Frames 231 x 111 on a 126 pitch, 41 units right of the hairline; 9-unit square markers centred on the line.
The current frame has a 2-unit amber border; its marker grows to 17 with an amber core and an amber connector to the frame.
decoration: The hairline, markers, connector and the dark band under each name: drawn.
